decision.summary: Landlord replied about an unapproved dog flap and a spare key after a lock change. The inspection report confirms the dog flap, which contradicts our earlier 'no issues' email, and the record shows no lock change. I corrected this with the landlord, asked the tenant about consent, the lock and a spare key, noted the conflicts, set a follow-up for 23 Feb and returned the job to auto.

args.recipient_name: Landlord (Oliver Bennett on record; email signed Felix Clarke)
args.body: Thank you for your email. First, a correction: our earlier email said no issues were found, but the inspection report (16 Feb) does note that a dog flap has been installed in the back door/utility room, and marks from sticker-type wall strips in Bedroom 1 that the tenant should remove and make good. Sorry for the confusion. On the dog flap: our records don't show any consent for it, so we are asking the tenant under the alterations and pets clauses whether permission was given and will report back. On the lock: our records don't show a lock change. We are asking the tenant who changed it and when, and asking for a spare front door key to be sent to the agency by 23 February. Please let us know if you gave consent for either, and whether you hold a key. Also, your email is signed Felix Clarke but our landlord record is Oliver Bennett; please confirm who you are so we can update the record. We will update you by 23 February.
